structure Mid where
  installed : Bool
  version : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def InstallCheckContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.version ≠ "" ∧ i.downloaded
  post := fun i m => m.installed = true ↔ i.downloaded ∧ m.version = i.version

def InstallVersionContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun _ => True
  post := fun m o => (o.installed = false → o.versionInstalled = "") ∧
                     (o.installed = true → o.versionInstalled = m.version)

structure Mid where
  found : List String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def ComputeFoundContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun _ => True
  post := fun i m => 
    (∀ r ∈ m.found, 
      (i.title.isSome → r = "title") ∧
      (i.username.isSome → r = "username") ∧
      (i.password.isSome → r = "password") ∧
      (i.url.isSome → r = "url") ∧
      (i.notes.isSome → r = "notes") ∧
      (i.groupName.isSome → r = "group name"))

def ShowResultsContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun _ => True
  post := fun m o => 
    (∀ r ∈ o.results, r ∈ m.found) ∧
    o.results.length ≤ 6 ∧
    (o.message = "No results were found." ↔ o.results = [])

theorem po1 : Contract.Compatible ComputeFoundContract ShowResultsContract := by
  discharge_po1 [ComputeFoundContract, ShowResultsContract, Spec]

theorem po2 : Contract.Refines (ComputeFoundContract.seq ShowResultsContract) Spec := by
  discharge_po2 [ComputeFoundContract, ShowResultsContract, Spec]

requirement_text: ìWhen the password field is changed the repeat password field must be Changed and be identical with password field

l1.error: static: `CheckPasswordsContract` is an identity: its `post` only copies `Input` fields, so `VerifyRepeatContract` does all the work of `Spec`. The first component must compute a result that is different for different inputs: give `Mid` a field for it and state it in the `post` of `CheckPasswordsContract` in terms of `i`. A field that is always the same (`m.ok = true`) does not count.; `VerifyRepeatContract` is an identity: its `post` only copies `Mid` fields to `Output`, so `CheckPasswordsContract` does all the work of `Spec`. Leave part of the work to `VerifyRepeatContract`: `CheckPasswordsContract` states an intermediate result in `Mid`, and `VerifyRepeatContract` states `o` in terms of it.
l1.code:
structure Mid where
  password  : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def CheckPasswordsContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => True
  post := fun i m => m.password = i.repeatPassword ∧ m.password = i.password

def VerifyRepeatContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun _ => True
  post := fun m o => o.repeatPassword = m.password ∧ o.password = m.password
